  B)   A system contains 5 processes (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5) and 3 resources (R1, R2, R3) with the               (5)  
  following number of instances:  
  
  R1: 2 instances  
  R2: 3 instances  
  R3: 2 instances  
  
  At a particular moment, the system's resource allocation status is:  
  
  P1 holds 1 instance of R1 and requests 1 instance of R2.  
  P2 holds 1 instance of R2, requests 1 instance of R3.  
  P3 holds 1 instance of R3, requests 1 instance of R1.  
  P4 holds 1 instance of R2 and is not requesting any other resource.  
  P5 is requesting 1 instance of R2 and 1 instance of R3 (but holds none currently).  
  Page #2

a) Draw the resource allocation graph, clearly indicating all allocations and requests.  
  b) Is the system in a deadlock state? Justify based on your RAG.  
  c) If one instance of R2 is released by P4, describe the resulting changes in the graph and process  
  states.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)        A computer system employs paging for memory management, featuring a 30-bit logical address        (5)  
  space and a page size of 16 KB. The physical memory available is 1 GB in size.  
  A)   Determine how many bits in the logical address are allocated to the page number and how many to  
  the page offset.  
  Calculate the total number of page frames in the physical memory and find the number of bits  
  required to represent the physical frame number.  
  Lastly, given a specific page table mapping page numbers 0 to 3 to frame numbers 10, 15, 22, and  
  45 respectively, translate the logical address 0x00345FA2 for this process into its corresponding  
  physical address.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)   Consider a computer system with the following characteristics:                                         (5)  
  
  Virtual address size: 40 bits  
  Page size: 16 KB  
  Each page table fits exactly in one page frame.  
  Page table size: 4 bytes  
  
  Find:  
  a) How many levels of page table will be required if each page table must fit into one page frame?  
  b) Calculate the physical memory size and calculate the total number of entries in the inverted page  
  table. Determine the size of the inverted page table in bytes using above data.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  B)   Consider a system with the following parameters:                                                       (5)  
  
  TLB access time = 20 ns  
  Main memory access time = 100 ns  
  $$The hit ratio of the TLB = 0.85$$  
  $$The page fault rate = 0.001$$  
  The page fault service time (including disk I/O) = 8 ms  
  
  Calculate the Effective Memory Access Time (EMAT)  
  
  
  Page #3

Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                       A magnetic disk has several defining characteristics that influence its performance. The disk            (5)  
  contains 2000 tracks, and the average seek time per track is 0.2 milliseconds. It spins at a rate of  
  A)               3600 revolutions per minute (RPM). The data transfer rate is 200 megabytes per second, and the  
  system transfers data in blocks of 4 kilobytes. Additionally, there is a controller overhead time of 8  
  milliseconds associated with disk operations.  
  Using these parameters, calculate the average seek time needed to position the read/write head,  
  the average rotational latency representing the delay waiting for the disk to rotate to the correct  
  position, the time taken to transfer the data block, and finally, the total average disk access time, to  
  estimate overall disk access performance.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO6" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)               A disk has 179 tracks. The disk arm is currently at track 64. The queue of requests in order is:         (5)  
  89,129,61,139,51,19,158,12089,129,61,139,51,19,158,120  
  Using the above, answer the following:  
  a) Calculate the total head movement (seek time) and show the order of servicing requests using:  
  
  C-SCAN Algorithm  
  LOOK Algorithm  
  C-LOOK Algorithm  
  SCAN Algorithm  
  SSTF Algorithm  
  
  b) Which algorithm provides the best average seek time for this request set? Justify briefly.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO6" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"
